items.name: flag-theme
items.title: Flag theme
items.description: Sets a Tier B app up for Flag: installs the runtime dependencies the Flag components share and the cn utility. The theme itself (shadcn variables mapped onto Flag tokens) is Flag's design-system/shadcn/theme.css, vendored with flag-sync next to the tokens and fonts.
items.docs: Next: vendor Flag's fonts/fonts.css, tokens/design-tokens.css, shadcn/theme.css and theme/theme-controller.js with scripts/flag-sync.sh, then import them in the app stylesheet after tailwindcss and tw-animate-css (fonts, tokens, theme, in that order). Fonts are Flag's Nebula Sans and Hack only; do not add font packages. Full steps: https://github.com/ElcanoTek/flag/blob/main/design-system/SHADCN.md
